description_en: Modifies the remote access IP address of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device
description_zh: 调用ModifySagRemoteAccess修改智能接入网关设备的远程访问IP
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-remote-access --smart-ag-id sag-r79m060r6oy55000000 --serial-number sag-100-v1p7-9 --remote-access-ip 10.10.10.2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagRemoteAccess

parameters.help_en: The ID of the corresponding SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number (SN) of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: serial_number

parameters.help_en: The remote access IP address of the SAG device
parameters.name: remote_access_ip
